description: Generate a video clip with sound from a text prompt on movoa.ai, or animate a photo by passing image_url (photo to video). Defaults to MiniMax H3 at 480p. Runs cost credits on your Movoa account, at the prices on https://movoa.ai/pricing. Video takes minutes: by default this returns a run id to poll with check_status.

duration.description: Seconds. minimax-h3: 4/5/6/8/10/15; seedance-2-5: 5–30 in steps of 5; seedance-2 family: 4/6/8/10; veo-3-1-fast: 8.

image_url.description: Optional photo (public https URL) used as the first frame — makes this photo to video.

prompt.description: The shot: what happens, where, how the camera moves, and what it sounds like.

wait.description: Block until the clip is ready (up to 30 minutes). Default false.

name: generate_video
title: Generate a video on Movoa
